    let mut i2c = self.i2c.borrow_mut();\n        i2c.write(self.addr, &amp;[TCA9554_CONFIG, 0b0111_1000])?;\n        i2c.write(self.addr, &amp;[TCA9554_POLARITY, 0x00])?;\n        i2c.write(self.addr, &amp;[TCA9554_OUTPUT, 0b1000_0110])?;\n        delay.delay_millis(20);\n        i2c.write(self.addr, &amp;[TCA9554_OUTPUT, 0b1000_0111])?;\n        delay.delay_millis(150);\n        Ok(())\n    }\n}\n\n// Type alias for the display driver to simplify the type\ntype DisplayDriver = Sh8601Driver&lt;\n    Ws18AmoledDriver,\n    SharedTca9554Reset,\n&gt;;\n\n// Display resource - NonSend because it contains non-thread-safe components\nstruct DisplayResource {\n    display: DisplayDriver,\n}\n\n// Button resources - NonSend because GPIO pins are not Send\nstruct ButtonLeftResource {\n    button: Input&lt;'static&gt;,\n}\n\n// TCA9554 resource for reading power button (EXIO4)\nstruct Tca9554Resource {\n    i2c: Rc&lt;core::cell::RefCell&lt;I2c&lt;'static, esp_hal::Blocking&gt;&gt;&gt;,\n    addr: u8,\n}\n\n// --- Game Systems ---\n\nfn input_system(\n    left_btn: NonSendMut&lt;ButtonLeftResource&gt;,\n    tca9554: NonSendMut&lt;Tca9554Resource&gt;,\n    mut input_state: ResMut&lt;InputState&gt;,\n    mut button_state: ResMut&lt;ButtonState&gt;,\n    mut debug_counter: ResMut&lt;DebugCounter&gt;,\n    game_state: Res&lt;GameState&gt;,\n) {\n    // GPIO0 (boot button) = left turn (active-low)\n    // EXIO4 (power button via TCA9554) = right turn (active-low)\n    // Both pressed = restart (during game)\n    // Single button long-press = restart (when game over)\n    let prev_left = button_state.left_pressed;\n    let prev_right = button_state.right_pressed;\n    let left_pressed = left_btn.button.is_low();\n    \n    // Read power button from TCA9554 EXIO4\n    let right_pressed = {\n        let mut i2c = tca9554.i2c.borrow_mut();\n        // Read input register (0x00)\n        let mut buf = [0u8; 1];\n        let read_result = i2c.write_read(tca9554.addr, &amp;[TCA9554_INPUT], &amp;mut buf);\n        if read_result.is_ok() {\n            // EXIO4 is bit 4, active-low (0 = pressed, 1 = not pressed)\n            // So we check if bit 4 is 0 (pressed) or 1 (not pressed)\n            (buf[0] &amp; (1 &lt;&lt; TCA9554_EXIO4_BIT)) == 0\n        } else {\n            false // On error, assume not pressed\n        }\n    };\n    let right_raw_low = right_pressed;\n    let right_raw_high = !right_pressed;\n    button_state.last_frame += 1;\n    \n    // Check for both buttons pressed (restart)\n    let both_pressed = left_pressed &amp;&amp; right_pressed;\n    let any_pressed = left_pressed || right_pressed;\n    \n    // When game is over, allow single-button long-press to restart\n    if game_state.game_over {\n        if any_pressed {\n            if button_state.single_button_hold_start.is_none() {\n                button_state.single_button_hold_start = Some(button_state.last_frame);\n                esp_println::println!(\"BTN: hold to restart...\");\n            } else if let Some(start_frame) = button_state.single_button_hold_start {\n                let hold_duration = button_state.last_frame - start_frame;\n                if hold_duration &gt;= SINGLE_BUTTON_RESTART_THRESHOLD &amp;&amp; !input_state.restart {\n                    input_state.restart = true;\n                    esp_println::println!(\"BTN: single button held long enough - restart!\");\n                }\n            }\n        } else {\n            button_state.single_button_hold_start = None;\n        }\n    } else {\n        button_state.single_button_hold_start = None;\n    }\n    \n    if both_pressed {\n        if !(prev_left &amp;&amp; prev_right) {\n            esp_println::println!(\"BTN: both pressed (boot+power)\");\n        }\n        // Both buttons pressed - check if held long enough for restart\n        if button_state.both_pressed_start.is_none() {\n            button_state.both_pressed_start = Some(button_state.last_frame);\n        } else if let Some(start_frame) = button_state.both_pressed_start {\n            let hold_duration = button_state.last_frame - start_frame;\n            if hold_duration &gt;= BOTH_BUTTONS_THRESHOLD {\n                input_state.restart = true;\n                esp_println::println!(\"BTN: both buttons held (restart)\");\n            }\n        }\n        // Don't process individual button presses when both are pressed\n        input_state.turn_left = false;\n        input_state.turn_right = false;\n    } else {\n        // Not both pressed - handle individual buttons\n        button_state.both_pressed_start = None;\n        // Don't clear restart flag here - let restart_system handle it\n        // input_state.restart = false; // Moved to restart_system\n        \n        // Simple debounce: button must be low for a few frames\n        if left_pressed {\n            button_state.left_debounce += 1;\n            if button_state.left_debounce &gt;= 3 {\n                input_state.turn_left = true;\n                if !prev_left &amp;&amp; button_state.left_debounce == 3 {\n                    esp_println::println!(\"BTN: left press (boot)\");\n                }\n            }\n        } else {\n            button_state.left_debounce = 0;\n            input_state.turn_left = false;\n        }\n        \n        if right_pressed {\n            button_state.right_debounce += 1;\n            if button_state.right_debounce &gt;= 3 {\n                input_state.turn_right = true;\n                if !prev_right &amp;&amp; button_state.right_debounce == 3 {\n                    esp_println::println!(\"BTN: right press (power/EXIO4)\");\n                }\n            }\n        } else {\n            button_state.right_debounce = 0;\n            input_state.turn_right = false;\n        }\n        \n        // Log any right button state change for debugging\n                if right_pressed != prev_right {\n                    esp_println::println!(\"BTN: Power button (EXIO4) {} (low={} high={})\", \n                        if right_pressed { \"pressed\" } else { \"released\" },\n                        right_raw_low, right_raw_high);\n                }\n    }\n    \n    button_state.left_pressed = left_pressed;\n    button_state.right_pressed = right_pressed;\n    \n    // Debug: log button states occasionally\n    debug_counter.count += 1;\n    if debug_counter.count % 100 == 0 {\n        esp_println::println!(\"BTN: left={} right={} (raw: low={} high={}) both={} game_over={}\", \n            left_pressed, right_pressed, right_raw_low, right_raw_high, both_pressed, game_state.game_over);\n    }\n}\n\nfn process_input_system(\n    mut input_state: ResMut&lt;InputState&gt;,\n    mut game_state: ResMut&lt;GameState&gt;,\n    mut head_query: Query&lt;&amp;mut Direction, With&lt;SnakeHead&gt;&gt;,\n) {\n    // Handle restart first (works even when game is over)\n    if input_state.restart {\n        // Restart will be handled by restart_system; skip other input\n        return;\n    }\n    \n    // Only process turn inputs if game is not over\n    if game_state.game_over {\n        return;\n    }\n    \n    // Lock turning until the snake moves again.\n    // This prevents \"multiple 90° turns while standing still\" which can effectively reverse direction\n    // before a move step and cause an unexpected immediate self-collision.\n    if game_state.turn_locked {\n        // still clear one-shot flags to avoid building up a backlog and spamming logs\n        input_state.turn_left = false;\n        input_state.turn_right = false;\n        return;\n    }\n\n    if let Ok(mut dir) = head_query.single_mut() {\n        // Process only one input per frame to avoid conflicts\n        // Right takes priority if both are pressed (shouldn't happen with new logic)\n        if input_state.turn_right {\n            *dir = dir.turn_right();\n            game_state.turn_locked = true;\n            game_state.needs_redraw = true;\n            input_state.turn_right = false;\n            esp_println::println!(\"Input: turn right\");\n        } else if input_state.turn_left {\n            *dir = dir.turn_left();\n            game_state.turn_locked = true;\n            game_state.needs_redraw = true;\n            input_state.turn_left = false;\n            esp_println::println!(\"Input: turn left\");\n        }\n    }\n}\n\nfn move_snake_system(\n    mut game_state: ResMut&lt;GameState&gt;,\n    mut head_query: Query&lt;(&amp;mut Position, &amp;Direction), With&lt;SnakeHead&gt;&gt;,\n    mut segment_query: Query&lt;(&amp;mut Position, &amp;SnakeSegment), (With&lt;SnakeSegment&gt;, Without&lt;SnakeHead&gt;)&gt;,\n) {\n    if game_state.game_over {\n        return;\n    }\n\n    game_state.frames_elapsed += 1;\n    game_state.move_timer += 1;\n    if game_state.move_timer &lt; game_state.move_interval {\n        return;\n    }\n    game_state.move_timer = 0;\n    game_state.needs_redraw = true; // Mark that we need to redraw after movement\n    game_state.turn_locked = false; // Allow another turn after each movement step\n\n    let (mut head_pos, direction) = match head_query.single_mut() {\n        Ok(h) =&gt; h,\n        Err(_) =&gt; return,\n    };\n\n    // Calculate new head position\n    let new_head_pos = match *direction {\n        Direction::Up =&gt; Position {\n            x: head_pos.x,\n            y: head_pos.y - 1,\n        },\n        Direction::Down =&gt; Position {\n            x: head_pos.x,\n            y: head_pos.y + 1,\n        },\n        Direction::Left =&gt; Position {\n            x: head_pos.x - 1,\n            y: head_pos.y,\n        },\n        Direction::Right =&gt; Position {\n            x: head_pos.x + 1,\n            y: head_pos.y,\n        },\n    };\n\n    // Store old head position\n    let old_head_pos = *head_pos;\n    \n    // Update head to new position\n    *head_pos = new_head_pos;\n\n    // Correct implementation of snake movement using indices\n    \n    // 1. Collect all segment data (index, old_position) BEFORE any updates\n    let mut segment_data: heapless::Vec&lt;(usize, Position), 256&gt; = heapless::Vec::new();\n    for (pos, seg) in segment_query.iter() {\n        segment_data.push((seg.index, *pos)).ok();\n    }\n    \n    // 2. Sort by index (ascending: 0, 1, 2...)\n    segment_data.sort_unstable_by_key(|(idx, _)| *idx);\n    \n    // Validate segment_data: check for duplicate indices or missing indices\n    let mut prev_idx = None;\n    for (idx, _) in segment_data.iter() {\n        if let Some(prev) = prev_idx {\n            if *idx == prev {\n                esp_println::println!(\"MOVE: ERROR - duplicate segment index {}\", idx);\n            } else if *idx != prev + 1 {\n                esp_println::println!(\"MOVE: WARNING - non-contiguous indices: {} -&gt; {}\", prev, idx);\n            }\n        }\n        prev_idx = Some(*idx);\n    }\n    \n    // Debug: log collected segment data occasionally\n    if segment_data.len() &gt; 0 &amp;&amp; game_state.frames_elapsed % 50 == 0 {\n        esp_println::println!(\"MOVE: head old=({}, {}) new=({}, {})\", \n            old_head_pos.x, old_head_pos.y, new_head_pos.x, new_head_pos.y);\n        for (idx, pos) in segment_data.iter() {\n            esp_println::println!(\"MOVE: segment_data[{}] = ({}, {})\", idx, pos.x, pos.y);\n        }\n    }\n    \n    // 3. Update segments in index order (0, 1, 2...) to ensure correctness\n    // We iterate through indices sequentially and find each segment by its index\n    let max_index = segment_data.iter().map(|(idx, _)| *idx).max().unwrap_or(0);\n    \n    for target_idx in 0..=max_index {\n        // Find the segment with this index and update it\n        for (mut pos, seg) in segment_query.iter_mut() {\n            if seg.index == target_idx {\n                if target_idx == 0 {\n                    // Segment 0 gets the old head position\n                    *pos = old_head_pos;\n                } else {\n                    // Segment i gets the old position of segment i-1\n                    // Find the old position of segment (target_idx - 1) in segment_data\n                    if let Some((prev_idx, prev_pos)) = segment_data.iter().find(|(idx, _)| *idx == target_idx - 1) {\n                        // Critical check: if the previous segment's old position is the new head position,\n                        // this indicates a serious bug in the movement logic\n                        if *prev_pos == new_head_pos {\n                            esp_println::println!(\"MOVE: CRITICAL ERROR - segment {} prev_seg[{}] old_pos=({}, {}) == new_head=({}, {})\", \n                                target_idx, prev_idx, prev_pos.x, prev_pos.y, new_head_pos.x, new_head_pos.y);\n                            esp_println::println!(\"MOVE: This should never happen! segment_data may be corrupted.\");\n                            // Don't update - leave segment at current position to avoid crash\n                            // Break out of inner loop to move to next target_idx\n                        } else {\n                            *pos = *prev_pos;\n                            \n                            // Debug: log segment updates occasionally\n                            if target_idx &lt;= 2 &amp;&amp; game_state.frames_elapsed % 50 == 0 {\n                                esp_println::println!(\"MOVE: updated segment {} to ({}, {})\", target_idx, pos.x, pos.y);\n                            }\n                        }\n                    } else {\n                        esp_println::println!(\"MOVE: ERROR - segment {} could not find previous segment {} in segment_data\", target_idx, target_idx - 1);\n                    }\n                }\n                \n                // Found this segment (whether updated or not), move to next index\n                break;\n            }\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n\nfn dump_game_state(\n    reason: &amp;str,\n    head_pos: &amp;Position,\n    head_dir: &amp;Direction,\n    game_state: &amp;GameState,\n    segment_query: &amp;Query&lt;(&amp;Position, &amp;SnakeSegment), (With&lt;SnakeSegment&gt;, Without&lt;SnakeHead&gt;)&gt;,\n    food_query: &amp;Query&lt;(Entity, &amp;Position), With&lt;Food&gt;&gt;,\n) {\n    const GRID_WIDTH: i32 = 46;\n    const GRID_HEIGHT: i32 = 56;\n    \n    let dir_str = match head_dir {\n        Direction::Up =&gt; \"Up\",\n        Direction::Down =&gt; \"Down\",\n        Direction::Left =&gt; \"Left\",\n        Direction::Right =&gt; \"Right\",\n    };\n    \n    esp_println::println!(\"=== GAME OVER: {} ===\", reason);\n    esp_println::println!(\"  Head: ({}, {}) facing {}\", head_pos.x, head_pos.y, dir_str);\n    esp_println::println!(\"  Grid: {}x{} (valid: 0..{}, 0..{})\", GRID_WIDTH, GRID_HEIGHT, GRID_WIDTH-1, GRID_HEIGHT-1);\n    esp_println::println!(\"  Score: {}, Frames: {}, Speed: {}\", game_state.score, game_state.frames_elapsed, game_state.move_interval);\n    \n    // Collect and sort segments by index\n    let mut segments: heapless::Vec&lt;(usize, i32, i32), 64&gt; = heapless::Vec::new();\n    for (pos, seg) in segment_query.iter() {\n        segments.push((seg.index, pos.x, pos.y)).ok();\n    }\n    segments.sort_unstable_by_key(|(idx, _, _)| *idx);\n    \n    esp_println::println!(\"  Segments ({}):\", segments.len());\n    for (idx, x, y) in segments.iter() {\n        esp_println::println!(\"    [{}]: ({}, {})\", idx, x, y);\n    }\n    \n    // Food positions\n    let mut food_count = 0;\n    for (_, food_pos) in food_query.iter() {\n        esp_println::println!(\"  Food: ({}, {})\", food_pos.x, food_pos.y);\n        food_count += 1;\n    }\n    if food_count == 0 {\n        esp_println::println!(\"  Food: none\");\n    }\n    esp_println::println!(\"=== END STATE DUMP ===\");\n}\n\nfn collision_system(\n    mut game_state: ResMut&lt;GameState&gt;,\n    head_query: Query&lt;(&amp;Position, &amp;Direction), With&lt;SnakeHead&gt;&gt;,\n    segment_query: Query&lt;(&amp;Position, &amp;SnakeSegment), (With&lt;SnakeSegment&gt;, Without&lt;SnakeHead&gt;)&gt;,\n    food_query: Query&lt;(Entity, &amp;Position), With&lt;Food&gt;&gt;,\n    mut commands: Commands,\n) {\n    if game_state.game_over {\n        return;\n    }\n\n    // Don't check collisions until snake has moved at least once\n    // This prevents false collisions on the first frame\n    if game_state.frames_elapsed &lt; game_state.move_interval {\n        return;\n    }\n\n    let (head_pos, head_dir) = match head_query.single() {\n        Ok((p, d)) =&gt; (*p, *d),\n        Err(_) =&gt; return,\n    };\n\n    // Check wall collision\n    const GRID_WIDTH: i32 = 46; // 368 / 8\n    const GRID_HEIGHT: i32 = 56; // 448 / 8\n    \n    if head_pos.x &lt; 0\n        || head_pos.x &gt;= GRID_WIDTH\n        || head_pos.y &lt; 0\n        || head_pos.y &gt;= GRID_HEIGHT\n    {\n        game_state.game_over = true;\n        game_state.needs_redraw = true;\n        dump_game_state(\"Wall collision\", &amp;head_pos, &amp;head_dir, &amp;game_state, &amp;segment_query, &amp;food_query);\n        return;\n    }\n\n    // Check self collision\n    // Skip segment 0 (index 0) because it's always at the old head position right after movement\n    // This prevents false collisions. Only check segments 1 and beyond.\n    for (seg_pos, seg) in segment_query.iter() {\n        if seg.index &gt; 0 &amp;&amp; *seg_pos == head_pos {\n            game_state.game_over = true;\n            game_state.needs_redraw = true;\n            esp_println::println!(\"=== GAME OVER: Self collision with segment {} ===\", seg.index);\n            dump_game_state(\"Self collision\", &amp;head_pos, &amp;head_dir, &amp;game_state, &amp;segment_query, &amp;food_query);\n            return;\n        }\n    }\n\n    // Check food collision\n    for (food_entity, food_pos) in food_query.iter() {\n        if *food_pos == head_pos {\n            // Eat food\n            commands.entity(food_entity).despawn();\n            game_state.score += 10;\n            \n            // Add new segment to snake\n            // Find the last segment (highest index)\n            // Use index to find tail, not position order which can be misleading if coiled\n            let max_index_seg = segment_query\n                .iter()\n                .max_by_key(|(_, s)| s.index);\n                \n            let (last_pos, next_index) = if let Some((pos, s)) = max_index_seg {\n                (*pos, s.index + 1)\n            } else {\n                (head_pos, 0)\n            };\n            \n            commands.spawn((\n                SnakeSegment { index: next_index },\n                Position {\n                    x: last_pos.x,\n                    y: last_pos.y,\n                },\n            ));\n\n            // Speed up slightly\n            if game_state.move_interval &gt; 2 {\n                game_state.move_interval -= 1;\n            }\n            game_state.needs_redraw = true;\n\n            esp_println::println!(\"Score: {}\", game_state.score);\n        }\n    }\n}\n\nfn restart_system(\n    mut input_state: ResMut&lt;InputState&gt;,\n    mut game_state: ResMut&lt;GameState&gt;,\n    mut head_query: Query&lt;&amp;mut Position, With&lt;SnakeHead&gt;&gt;,\n    mut head_dir_query: Query&lt;&amp;mut Direction, With&lt;SnakeHead&gt;&gt;,\n    segment_query: Query&lt;Entity, With&lt;SnakeSegment&gt;&gt;,\n    food_query: Query&lt;Entity, With&lt;Food&gt;&gt;,\n    mut commands: Commands,\n) {\n    if !input_state.restart {\n        return;\n    }\n    \n    esp_println::println!(\"=== RESTART SYSTEM TRIGGERED ===\");\n    esp_println::println!(\"  game_over was: {}\", game_state.game_over);\n    \n    // Clear restart flag immediately to prevent multiple restarts\n    input_state.restart = false;\n    \n    // Reset game state\n    *game_state = GameState::default();\n    \n    // Remove all segments\n    for entity in segment_query.iter() {\n        commands.entity(entity).despawn();\n    }\n    \n    // Remove all food\n    for entity in food_query.iter() {\n        commands.entity(entity).despawn();\n    }\n    \n    // Reset head position and direction\n    if let Ok(mut head_pos) = head_query.single_mut() {\n        *head_pos = Position { x: 23, y: 28 }; // Center of grid\n    }\n    if let Ok(mut dir) = head_dir_query.single_mut() {\n        *dir = Direction::Right;\n    }\n    \n    // Spawn initial segments\n    commands.spawn((\n        SnakeSegment { index: 0 },\n        Position { x: 22, y: 28 },\n    ));\n    commands.spawn((\n        SnakeSegment { index: 1 },\n        Position { x: 21, y: 28 },\n    ));\n    \n    game_state.needs_redraw = true;\n    esp_println::println!(\"Game restarted!\");\n}\n\nfn food_spawn_system(\n    mut commands: Commands,\n    food_query: Query&lt;Entity, With&lt;Food&gt;&gt;,\n    all_positions: Query&lt;&amp;Position&gt;,\n    rng: ResMut&lt;RngResource&gt;,\n    game_state: Res&lt;GameState&gt;,\n) {\n    if game_state.game_over {\n        return;\n    }\n\n    // Only spawn food if none exists\n    if food_query.iter().next().is_some() {\n        return;\n    }\n\n    const GRID_WIDTH: i32 = 46;\n    const GRID_HEIGHT: i32 = 56;\n\n    // Try to find a free position\n    let mut attempts = 0;\n    loop {\n        let mut buf = [0u8; 4];\n        rng.0.read(&amp;mut buf);\n        let x = ((buf[0] as u32 | ((buf[1] as u32) &lt;&lt; 8)) % GRID_WIDTH as u32) as i32;\n        rng.0.read(&amp;mut buf);\n        let y = ((buf[0] as u32 | ((buf[1] as u32) &lt;&lt; 8)) % GRID_HEIGHT as u32) as i32;\n\n        let pos = Position { x, y };\n        let occupied = all_positions.iter().any(|&amp;p| p == pos);\n\n        if !occupied {\n            commands.spawn((Food, pos));\n            break;\n        }\n\n        attempts += 1;\n        if attempts &gt; 100 {\n            // Give up if we can't find a spot\n            break;\n        }\n    }\n}\n\nfn render_system(\n    mut display_res: NonSendMut&lt;DisplayResource&gt;,\n    mut game_state: ResMut&lt;GameState&gt;,\n    mut fb_res: ResMut&lt;FrameBufferResource&gt;,\n    head_query: Query&lt;&amp;Position, With&lt;SnakeHead&gt;&gt;,\n    segment_query: Query&lt;&amp;Position, With&lt;SnakeSegment&gt;&gt;,\n    food_query: Query&lt;&amp;Position, With&lt;Food&gt;&gt;,\n    _perf_metrics: Option&lt;Res&lt;PerformanceMetrics&gt;&gt;,\n) {\n    // Only render when needed (after movement or state change)\n    // For game over, only render once when it first happens\n    if !game_state.needs_redraw {\n        return;\n    }\n    game_state.needs_redraw = false;\n    // Clear framebuffer\n    fb_res.frame_buf.clear(Rgb888::BLACK).unwrap();\n\n    const CELL_SIZE: i32 = 8;\n    const GRID_OFFSET_X: i32 = 0;\n    const GRID_OFFSET_Y: i32 = 0;\n    \n    // Direct framebuffer writes for game objects (much faster than embedded-graphics primitives)\n    // Access the underlying array slice from HeapBuffer\n    let fb_data: &amp;mut [Rgb888] = &amp;mut *fb_res.frame_buf.data;\n    \n    // Helper function to fill a cell in the framebuffer\n    #[inline(always)]\n    fn fill_cell(fb_data: &amp;mut [Rgb888], x: usize, y: usize, color: Rgb888, cell_size: usize) {\n        if x + cell_size &lt;= LCD_H_RES &amp;&amp; y + cell_size &lt;= LCD_V_RES {\n            for dy in 0..cell_size {\n                let row_start = (y + dy) * LCD_H_RES + x;\n                for dx in 0..cell_size {\n                    fb_data[row_start + dx] = color;\n                }\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    // Draw food (red)\n    for food_pos in food_query.iter() {\n        let screen_x = GRID_OFFSET_X + food_pos.x * CELL_SIZE;\n        let screen_y = GRID_OFFSET_Y + food_pos.y * CELL_SIZE;\n        // Bounds check: skip if position is out of bounds (prevents panic from negative -&gt; usize conversion)\n        if screen_x &gt;= 0 &amp;&amp; screen_y &gt;= 0 \n            &amp;&amp; (screen_x as usize) + (CELL_SIZE as usize) &lt;= LCD_H_RES \n            &amp;&amp; (screen_y as usize) + (CELL_SIZE as usize) &lt;= LCD_V_RES {\n            let x = screen_x as usize;\n            let y = screen_y as usize;\n            fill_cell(fb_data, x, y, Rgb888::new(255, 0, 0), CELL_SIZE as usize);\n        }\n    }\n\n    // Draw snake segments (green)\n    for seg_pos in segment_query.iter() {\n        let screen_x = GRID_OFFSET_X + seg_pos.x * CELL_SIZE;\n        let screen_y = GRID_OFFSET_Y + seg_pos.y * CELL_SIZE;\n        // Bounds check: skip if position is out of bounds (prevents panic from negative -&gt; usize conversion)\n        if screen_x &gt;= 0 &amp;&amp; screen_y &gt;= 0 \n            &amp;&amp; (screen_x as usize) + (CELL_SIZE as frame_time_us;\n        if frame_time_us &gt; self.max_frame_time_us {\n            self.max_frame_time_us = frame_time_us;\n        }\n        if frame_time_us &lt; self.min_frame_time_us {\n            self.min_frame_time_us = frame_time_us;\n        }\n    }\n    \n    fn log_performance(&amp;mut self) {\n        if self.frame_count == 0 {\n            return;\n        }\n        \n        let avg_frame_time_us = self.total_frame_time_us / self.frame_count as u64;\n        let avg_fps = if avg_frame_time_us &gt; 0 {\n            1_000_000 / avg_frame_time_us\n        } else {\n            0\n        };\n        \n        esp_println::println!(\"=== Performance ({} frames) ===\", self.frame_count);\n        esp_println::println!(\"  Avg: {} us ({} FPS)\", avg_frame_time_us, avg_fps);\n        esp_println::println!(\"  Min: {} us\", self.min_frame_time_us);\n        esp_println::println!(\"  Max: {} us\", self.max_frame_time_us);\n        \n        // Reset for next measurement period\n        self.frame_count = 0;\n        self.total_frame_time_us = 0;\n        self.max_frame_time_us = 0;\n        self.min_frame_time_us = u64::MAX;\n    }\n    \n    fn get_current_fps(&amp;self) -&gt; u32 {\n        if self.frame_count == 0 {\n            return 0;\n        }\n        let avg_frame_time_us = self.total_frame_time_us / self.frame_count as u64;\n        if avg_frame_time_us &gt; 0 {\n            (1_000_000 / avg_frame_time_us) as u32\n        } else {\n            0\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n\n#[derive(Resource, Default)]\nstruct ButtonState {\n    left_pressed: bool,\n    right_pressed: bool,\n    both_pressed_start: Option&lt;u32&gt;, // Frame when both buttons were pressed\n    single_button_hold_start: Option&lt;u32&gt;, // Frame when single button was pressed (for game-over restart)\n    last_frame: u32,\n    left_debounce: u32,\n    right_debounce: u32,\n}\n\nconst BOTH_BUTTONS_THRESHOLD: u32 = 5; // Frames both buttons must be held for restart\nconst SINGLE_BUTTON_RESTART_THRESHOLD: u32 = 30; // Frames single button must be held to restart when game over (~1 second)\n\n// Shared TCA9554 reset interface that uses Rc to share I2C bus\nstruct SharedTca9554Reset {\n    i2c: Rc&lt;core::cell::RefCell&lt;I2c&lt;'static, esp_hal::Blocking&gt;&gt;&gt;,\n    addr: u8,\n}\n\nimpl ResetInterface for SharedTca9554Reset {\n    type Error = &lt;I2c&lt;'static, esp_hal::Blocking&gt; as embedded_hal::i2c::ErrorType&gt;::Error;\n    \n    fn reset(&amp;mut self) -&gt; Result&lt;(), Self::Error&gt; {\n        let delay = Delay::new();\n        let mut i2c = self.i2c.borrow_mut();\n        i2c.write(self.addr, &amp;[TCA9554_CONFIG, 0b0111_1000])?;\n        i2c.write(self.addr, &amp;[TCA9554_POLARITY, 0x00])?;\n        i2c.write(self.addr, &amp;[TCA9554_OUTPUT, 0b1000_0110])?;\n        delay.delay_millis(20);\n        i2c.write(self.addr, &amp;[TCA9554_OUTPUT, 0b1000_0111])?;\n        delay.delay_millis(150);\n        Ok(())\n    }\n}\n\n// Type alias for the display driver to simplify the type\ntype DisplayDriver = Sh8601Driver&lt;\n    Ws18AmoledDriver,\n    SharedTca9554Reset,\n&gt;;\n\n// Display resource - NonSend because it contains non-thread-safe components\nstruct DisplayResource {\n    display: DisplayDriver,\n}\n\n// Button resources - NonSend because GPIO pins are not Send\nstruct ButtonLeftResource {\n    button: Input&lt;'static&gt;,\n}\n\n// TCA9554 resource for reading power button (EXIO4)\nstruct Tca9554Resource {\n    i2c: Rc&lt;core::cell::RefCell&lt;I2c&lt;'static, esp_hal::Blocking&gt;&gt;&gt;,\n    addr: u8,\n}\n\n// --- Game Systems ---\n\nfn input_system(\n    left_btn: NonSendMut&lt;ButtonLeftResource&gt;,\n    tca9554: NonSendMut&lt;Tca9554Resource&gt;,\n    mut input_state: ResMut&lt;InputState&gt;,\n    mut button_state: ResMut&lt;ButtonState&gt;,\n    mut debug_counter: ResMut&lt;DebugCounter&gt;,\n    game_state: Res&lt;GameState&gt;,\n) {\n    // GPIO0 (boot button) = left turn (active-low)\n    // EXIO4 (power button via TCA9554) = right turn (active-low)\n    // Both pressed = restart (during game)\n    // Single button long-press = restart (when game over)\n    let prev_left = button_state.left_pressed;\n    let prev_right = button_state.right_pressed;\n    let left_pressed = left_btn.button.is_low();\n    \n    // Read power button from TCA9554 EXIO4\n    let right_pressed = {\n        let mut i2c = tca9554.i2c.borrow_mut();\n        // Read input register (0x00)\n        let mut buf = [0u8; 1];\n        let read_result = i2c.write_read(tca9554.addr, &amp;[TCA9554_INPUT], &amp;mut buf);\n        if read_result.is_ok() {\n            // EXIO4 is bit 4, active-low (0 = pressed, 1 = not pressed)\n            // So we check if bit 4 is 0 (pressed) or 1 (not pressed)\n            (buf[0] &amp; (1 &lt;&lt; TCA9554_EXIO4_BIT)) == 0\n        } else {\n            false // On error, assume not pressed\n        }\n    };\n    let right_raw_low = right_pressed;\n    let right_raw_high = !right_pressed;\n    button_state.last_frame += 1;\n    \n    // Check for both buttons pressed (restart)\n    let both_pressed = left_pressed &amp;&amp; right_pressed;\n    let any_pressed = left_pressed || right_pressed;\n    \n    // When game is over, allow single-button long-press to restart\n    if game_state.game_over {\n        if any_pressed {\n            if button_state.single_button_hold_start.is_none() {\n                button_state.single_button_hold_start = Some(button_state.last_frame);\n                esp_println::println!(\"BTN: hold to restart...\");\n            } else if let Some(start_frame) = button_state.single_button_hold_start {\n                let hold_duration = button_state.last_frame - start_frame;\n                if hold_duration &gt;= SINGLE_BUTTON_RESTART_THRESHOLD &amp;&amp; !input_state.restart {\n                    input_state.restart = true;\n                    esp_println::println!(\"BTN: single button held long enough - restart!\");\n                }\n            }\n        } else {\n            button_state.single_button_hold_start = None;\n        }\n    } else {\n        button_state.single_button_hold_start = None;\n    }\n    \n    if both_pressed {\n        if !(prev_left &amp;&amp; prev_right) {\n            esp_println::println!(\"BTN: both pressed (boot+power)\");\n        }\n        // Both buttons pressed - check if held long enough for restart\n        if button_state.both_pressed_start.is_none() {\n            button_state.both_pressed_start = Some(button_state.last_frame);\n        } else if let Some(start_frame) = button_state.both_pressed_start {\n            let hold_duration = button_state.last_frame - start_frame;\n            if hold_duration &gt;= BOTH_BUTTONS_THRESHOLD {\n                input_state.restart = true;\n                esp_println::println!(\"BTN: both buttons held (restart)\");\n            }\n        }\n        // Don't process individual button presses when both are pressed\n        input_state.turn_left = false;\n        input_state.turn_right = false;\n    } else {\n        // Not both pressed - handle individual buttons\n        button_state.both_pressed_start = None;\n        // Don't clear restart flag here - let restart_system handle it\n        // input_state.restart = false; // Moved to restart_system\n        \n        // Simple debounce: button must be low for a few frames\n        if left_pressed {\n            button_state.left_debounce += 1;\n            if button_state.left_debounce &gt;= 3 {\n                input_state.turn_left = true;\n                if !prev_left &amp;&amp; button_state.left_debounce == 3 {\n                    esp_println::println!(\"BTN: left press (boot)\");\n                }\n            }\n        } else {\n            button_state.left_debounce = 0;\n            input_state.turn_left = false;\n        }\n        \n        if right_pressed {\n            button_state.right_debounce += 1;\n            if button_state.right_debounce &gt;= 3 {\n                input_state.turn_right = true;\n                if !prev_right &amp;&amp; button_state.right_debounce == 3 {\n                    esp_println::println!(\"BTN: right press (power/EXIO4)\");\n                }\n            }\n        } else {\n            button_state.right_debounce = 0;\n            input_state.turn_right = false;\n        }\n        \n        // Log any right button state change for debugging\n                if right_pressed != prev_right {\n                    esp_println::println!(\"BTN: Power button (EXIO4) {} (low={} high={})\", \n                        if right_pressed { \"pressed\" } else { \"released\" },\n                        right_raw_low, right_raw_high);\n                }\n    }\n    \n    button_state.left_pressed = left_pressed;\n    button_state.right_pressed = right_pressed;\n    \n    // Debug: log button states occasionally\n    debug_counter.count += 1;\n    if debug_counter.count % 100 == 0 {\n        esp_println::println!(\"BTN: left={} right={} (raw: low={} high={}) both={} game_over={}\", \n            left_pressed, right_pressed, right_raw_low, right_raw_high, both_pressed, game_state.game_over);\n    }\n}\n\nfn process_input_system(\n    mut input_state: ResMut&lt;InputState&gt;,\n    mut game_state: ResMut&lt;GameState&gt;,\n    mut head_query: Query&lt;&amp;mut Direction, With&lt;SnakeHead&gt;&gt;,\n) {\n    // Handle restart first (works even when game is over)\n    if input_state.restart {\n        // Restart will be handled by restart_system; skip other input\n        return;\n    }\n    \n    // Only process turn inputs if game is not over\n    if game_state.game_over {\n        return;\n    }\n    \n    // Lock turning until the snake moves again.\n    // This prevents \"multiple 90° turns while standing still\" which can effectively reverse direction\n    // before a move step and cause an unexpected immediate self-collision.\n    if game_state.turn_locked {\n        // still clear one-shot flags to avoid building up a backlog and spamming logs\n        input_state.turn_left = false;\n        input_state.turn_right = false;\n        return;\n    }\n\n    if let Ok(mut dir) = head_query.single_mut() {\n        // Process only one input per frame to avoid conflicts\n        // Right takes priority if both are pressed (shouldn't happen with new logic)\n        if input_state.turn_right {\n            *dir = dir.turn_right();\n            game_state.turn_locked = true;\n            game_state.needs_redraw = true;\n            input_state.turn_right = false;\n            esp_println::println!(\"Input: turn right\");\n        } else if input_state.turn_left {\n            *dir = dir.turn_left();\n            game_state.turn_locked = true;\n            game_state.needs_redraw = true;\n            input_state.turn_left = false;\n            esp_println::println!(\"Input: turn left\");\n        }\n    }\n}\n\nfn move_snake_system(\n    mut game_state: ResMut&lt;GameState&gt;,\n    mut head_query: Query&lt;(&amp;mut Position, &amp;Direction), With&lt;SnakeHead&gt;&gt;,\n    mut segment_query: Query&lt;(&amp;mut Position, &amp;SnakeSegment), (With&lt;SnakeSegment&gt;, Without&lt;SnakeHead&gt;)&gt;,\n) {\n    if game_state.game_over {\n        return;\n    }\n\n    game_state.frames_elapsed += 1;\n    game_state.move_timer += 1;\n    if game_state.move_timer &lt; game_state.move_interval {\n        return;\n    }\n    game_state.move_timer = 0;\n    game_state.needs_redraw = true; // Mark that we need to redraw after movement\n    game_state.turn_locked = false; // Allow another turn after each movement step\n\n    let (mut head_pos, direction) = match head_query.single_mut() {\n        Ok(h) =&gt; h,\n        Err(_) =&gt; return,\n    };\n\n    // Calculate new head position\n    let new_head_pos = match *direction {\n        Direction::Up =&gt; Position {\n            x: head_pos.x,\n            y: head_pos.y - 1,\n        },\n        Direction::Down =&gt; Position {\n            x: head_pos.x,\n            y: head_pos.y + 1,\n        },\n        Direction::Left =&gt; Position {\n            x: head_pos.x - 1,\n            y: head_pos.y,\n        },\n        Direction::Right =&gt; Position {\n            x: head_pos.x + 1,\n            y: head_pos.y,\n        },\n    };\n\n    // Store old head position\n    let old_head_pos = *head_pos;\n    \n    // Update head to new position\n    *head_pos = new_head_pos;\n\n    // Correct implementation of snake movement using indices\n    \n    // 1. Collect all segment data (index, old_position) BEFORE any updates\n    let mut segment_data: heapless::Vec&lt;(usize, Position), 256&gt; = heapless::Vec::new();\n    for (pos, seg) in segment_query.iter() {\n        segment_data.push((seg.index, *pos)).ok();\n    }\n    \n    // 2. Sort by index (ascending: 0, 1, 2...)\n    segment_data.sort_unstable_by_key(|(idx, _)| *idx);\n    \n    // Validate segment_data: check for duplicate indices or missing indices\n    let mut prev_idx = None;\n    for (idx, _) in segment_data.iter() {\n        if let Some(prev) = prev_idx {\n            if *idx == prev {\n                esp_println::println!(\"MOVE: ERROR - duplicate segment index {}\", idx);\n            } else if *idx != prev + 1 {\n                esp_println::println!(\"MOVE: WARNING - non-contiguous indices: {} -&gt; {}\", prev, idx);\n            }\n        }\n        prev_idx = Some(*idx);\n    }\n    \n    // Debug: log collected segment data occasionally (kept lightweight)\n    if segment_data.len() &gt; 0 &amp;&amp; game_state.frames_elapsed % 200 == 0 {\n        esp_println::println!(\n            \"MOVE: head old=({}, {}) new=({}, {}) segs={}\",\n            old_head_pos.x,\n            old_head_pos.y,\n            new_head_pos.x,\n            new_head_pos.y,\n            segment_data.len()\n        );\n    }\n    \n    // 3. Update segments in index order (0, 1, 2...) to ensure correctness\n    // We iterate through indices sequentially and find each segment by its index\n    let max_index = segment_data.iter().map(|(idx, _)| *idx).max().unwrap_or(0);\n    \n    for target_idx in 0..=max_index {\n        // Find the segment with this index and update it\n        for (mut pos, seg) in segment_query.iter_mut() {\n            if seg.index == target_idx {\n                if target_idx == 0 {\n                    // Segment 0 gets the old head position\n                    *pos = old_head_pos;\n                } else {\n                    // Segment i gets the old position of segment i-1\n                    // Find the old position of segment (target_idx - 1) in segment_data\n                    if let Some((prev_idx, prev_pos)) = segment_data.iter().find(|(idx, _)| *idx == target_idx - 1) {\n                        // Critical check: if the previous segment's old position is the new head position,\n                        // this indicates a serious bug in the movement logic\n                        if *prev_pos == new_head_pos {\n                            esp_println::println!(\"MOVE: CRITICAL ERROR - segment {} prev_seg[{}] old_pos=({}, {}) == new_head=({}, {})\", \n                                target_idx, prev_idx, prev_pos.x, prev_pos.y, new_head_pos.x, new_head_pos.y);\n                            esp_println::println!(\"MOVE: This should never happen! segment_data may be corrupted.\");\n                            // Don't update - leave segment at current position to avoid crash\n                            // Break out of inner loop to move to next target_idx\n                        } else {\n                            *pos = *prev_pos;\n                            \n                            // Debug: log segment updates occasionally\n                            if target_idx &lt;= 2 &amp;&amp; game_state.frames_elapsed % 50 == 0 {\n                                esp_println::println!(\"MOVE: updated segment {} to ({}, {})\", target_idx, pos.x, pos.y);\n                            }\n                        }\n                    } else {\n                        esp_println::println!(\"MOVE: ERROR - segment {} could not find previous segment {} in segment_data\", target_idx, target_idx - 1);\n                    }\n                }\n                \n                // Found this segment (whether updated or not), move to next index\n                break;\n            }\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n\nfn dump_game_state(\n    reason: &amp;str,\n    head_pos: &amp;Position,\n    head_dir: &amp;Direction,\n    game_state: &amp;GameState,\n    segment_query: &amp;Query&lt;(&amp;Position, &amp;SnakeSegment), (With&lt;SnakeSegment&gt;, Without&lt;SnakeHead&gt;)&gt;,\n    food_query: &amp;Query&lt;(Entity, &amp;Position), With&lt;Food&gt;&gt;,\n) {\n    const GRID_WIDTH: i32 = 46;\n    const GRID_HEIGHT: i32 = 56;\n    \n    let dir_str = match head_dir {\n        Direction::Up =&gt; \"Up\",\n        Direction::Down =&gt; \"Down\",\n        Direction::Left =&gt; \"Left\",\n        Direction::Right =&gt; \"Right\",\n    };\n    \n    esp_println::println!(\"=== GAME OVER: {} ===\", reason);\n    esp_println::println!(\"  Head: ({}, {}) facing {}\", head_pos.x, head_pos.y, dir_str);\n    esp_println::println!(\"  Grid: {}x{} (valid: 0..{}, 0..{})\", GRID_WIDTH, GRID_HEIGHT, GRID_WIDTH-1, GRID_HEIGHT-1);\n    esp_println::println!(\"  Score: {}, Frames: {}, Speed: {}\", game_state.score, game_state.frames_elapsed, game_state.move_interval);\n    \n    // Collect and sort segments by index\n    let mut segments: heapless::Vec&lt;(usize, i32, i32), 64&gt; = heapless::Vec::new();\n    for (pos, seg) in segment_query.iter() {\n        segments.push((seg.index, pos.x, pos.y)).ok();\n    }\n    segments.sort_unstable_by_key(|(idx, _, _)| *idx);\n    \n    esp_println::println!(\"  Segments ({}):\", segments.len());\n    for (idx, x, y) in segments.iter() {\n        esp_println::println!(\"    [{}]: ({}, {})\", idx, x, y);\n    }\n    \n    // Food positions\n    let mut food_count = 0;\n    for (_, food_pos) in food_query.iter() {\n        esp_println::println!(\"  Food: ({}, {})\", food_pos.x, food_pos.y);\n        food_count += 1;\n    }\n    if food_count == 0 {\n        esp_println::println!(\"  Food: none\");\n    }\n    esp_println::println!(\"=== END STATE DUMP ===\");\n}\n\nfn collision_system(\n    mut game_state: ResMut&lt;GameState&gt;,\n    head_query: Query&lt;(&amp;Position, &amp;Direction), With&lt;SnakeHead&gt;&gt;,\n    segment_query: Query&lt;(&amp;Position, &amp;SnakeSegment), (With&lt;SnakeSegment&gt;, Without&lt;SnakeHead&gt;)&gt;,\n    food_query: Query&lt;(Entity, &amp;Position), With&lt;Food&gt;&gt;,\n    mut commands: Commands,\n) {\n    if game_state.game_over {\n        return;\n    }\n\n    // Don't check collisions until snake has moved at least once\n    // This prevents false collisions on the first frame\n    if game_state.frames_elapsed &lt; game_state.move_interval {\n        return;\n    }\n\n    let (head_pos, head_dir) = match head_query.single() {\n        Ok((p, d)) =&gt; (*p, *d),\n        Err(_) =&gt; return,\n    };\n\n    // Check wall collision\n    const GRID_WIDTH: i32 = 46; // 368 / 8\n    const GRID_HEIGHT: i32 = 56; // 448 / 8\n    \n    if head_pos.x &lt; 0\n        || head_pos.x &gt;= GRID_WIDTH\n        || head_pos.y &lt; 0\n        || head_pos.y &gt;= GRID_HEIGHT\n    {\n        game_state.game_over = true;\n        game_state.needs_redraw = true;\n        dump_game_state(\"Wall collision\", &amp;head_pos, &amp;head_dir, &amp;game_state, &amp;segment_query, &amp;food_query);\n        return;\n    }\n\n    // Check self collision\n    // Skip segment 0 (index 0) because it's always at the old head position right after movement\n    // This prevents false collisions. Only check segments 1 and beyond.\n    for (seg_pos, seg) in segment_query.iter() {\n        if seg.index &gt; 0 &amp;&amp; *seg_pos == head_pos {\n            game_state.game_over = true;\n            game_state.needs_redraw = true;\n            esp_println::println!(\"=== GAME OVER: Self collision with segment {} ===\", seg.index);\n            dump_game_state(\"Self collision\", &amp;head_pos, &amp;head_dir, &amp;game_state, &amp;segment_query, &amp;food_query);\n            return;\n        }\n    }\n\n    // Check food collision\n    for (food_entity, food_pos) in food_query.iter() {\n        if *food_pos == head_pos {\n            // Eat food\n            commands.entity(food_entity).despawn();\n            game_state.score += 10;\n            \n            // Add new segment to snake\n            // Find the last segment (highest index)\n            // Use index to find tail, not position order which can be misleading if coiled\n            let max_index_seg = segment_query\n                .iter()\n                .max_by_key(|(_, s)| s.index);\n                \n            let (last_pos, next_index) = if let Some((pos, s)) = max_index_seg {\n                (*pos, s.index + 1)\n            } else {\n                (head_pos, 0)\n            };\n            \n            commands.spawn((\n                SnakeSegment { index: next_index },\n                Position {\n                    x: last_pos.x,\n                    y: last_pos.y,\n                },\n            ));\n\n            // Speed up slightly\n            if game_state.move_interval &gt; 2 {\n                game_state.move_interval -= 1;\n            }\n            game_state.needs_redraw = true;\n\n            esp_println::println!(\"Score: {}\", game_state.score);\n        }\n    }\n}\n\nfn restart_system(\n    mut input_state: ResMut&lt;InputState&gt;,\n    mut game_state: ResMut&lt;GameState&gt;,\n    mut head_query: Query&lt;&amp;mut Position, With&lt;SnakeHead&gt;&gt;,\n    mut head_dir_query: Query&lt;&amp;mut Direction, With&lt;SnakeHead&gt;&gt;,\n    segment_query: Query&lt;Entity, With&lt;SnakeSegment&gt;&gt;,\n    food_query: Query&lt;Entity, With&lt;Food&gt;&gt;,\n    mut commands: Commands,\n) {\n    if !input_state.restart {\n        return;\n    }\n    \n    esp_println::println!(\"=== RESTART SYSTEM TRIGGERED ===\");\n    esp_println::println!(\"  game_over was: {}\", game_state.game_over);\n    \n    // Clear restart flag immediately to prevent multiple restarts\n    input_state.restart = false;\n    \n    // Reset game state\n    *game_state = GameState::default();\n    \n    // Remove all segments\n    for entity in segment_query.iter() {\n        commands.entity(entity).despawn();\n    }\n    \n    // Remove all food\n    for entity in food_query.iter() {\n        commands.entity(entity).despawn();\n    }\n    \n    // Reset head position and direction\n    if let Ok(mut head_pos) = head_query.single_mut() {\n        *head_pos = Position { x: 23, y: 28 }; // Center of grid\n    }\n    if let Ok(mut dir) = head_dir_query.single_mut() {\n        *dir = Direction::Right;\n    }\n    \n    // Spawn initial segments\n    commands.spawn((\n        SnakeSegment { index: 0 },\n        Position { x: 22, y: 28 },\n    ));\n    commands.spawn((\n        SnakeSegment { index: 1 },\n        Position { x: 21, y: 28 },\n    ));\n    \n    game_state.needs_redraw = true;\n    esp_println::println!(\"Game restarted!\");\n}\n\nfn food_spawn_system(\n    mut commands: Commands,\n    food_query: Query&lt;Entity, With&lt;Food&gt;&gt;,\n    all_positions: Query&lt;&amp;Position&gt;,\n    rng: ResMut&lt;RngResource&gt;,\n    game_state: Res&lt;GameState&gt;,\n) {\n    if game_state.game_over {\n        return;\n    }\n\n    // Only spawn food if none exists\n    if food_query.iter().next().is_some() {\n        return;\n    }\n\n    const GRID_WIDTH: i32 = 46;\n    const GRID_HEIGHT: i32 = 56;\n\n    // Try to find a free position\n    let mut attempts = 0;\n    loop {\n        let mut buf = [0u8; 4];\n        rng.0.read(&amp;mut buf);\n        let x = ((buf[0] as u32 | ((buf[1] as u32) &lt;&lt; 8)) % GRID_WIDTH as u32) as i32;\n        rng.0.read(&amp;mut buf);\n        let y = ((buf[0] as u32 | ((buf[1] as u32) &lt;&lt; 8)) % GRID_HEIGHT as u32) as i32;\n\n        let pos = Position { x, y };\n        let occupied = all_positions.iter().any(|&amp;p| p == pos);\n\n        if !occupied {\n            commands.spawn((Food, pos));\n            break;\n        }\n\n        attempts += 1;\n        if attempts &gt; 100 {\n            // Give up if we can't find a spot\n            break;\n        }\n    }\n}\n\nfn render_system(\n    mut display_res: NonSendMut&lt;DisplayResource&gt;,\n    mut game_state: ResMut&lt;GameState&gt;,\n    mut fb_res: ResMut&lt;FrameBufferResource&gt;,\n    head_query: Query&lt;&amp;Position, With&lt;SnakeHead&gt;&gt;,\n    segment_query: Query&lt;&amp;Position, With&lt;SnakeSegment&gt;&gt;,\n    food_query: Query&lt;&amp;Position, With&lt;Food&gt;&gt;,\n ---\n\n#[derive(Resource)]\nstruct FrameBufferResource {\n    frame_buf: MyFrameBuf,\n}\n\nimpl FrameBufferResource {\n    fn new() -&gt; Self {\n        let fb_data: Box&lt;[Rgb888; LCD_BUFFER_SIZE]&gt; = Box::new([Rgb888::BLACK; LCD_BUFFER_SIZE]);\n        let heap_buffer = HeapBuffer::new(fb_data);\n        let frame_buf = MyFrameBuf::new(heap_buffer, LCD_H_RES, LCD_V_RES);\n        Self { frame_buf }\n    }\n}\n\n#[derive(Resource)]\nstruct GameState {\n    score: u32,\n    game_over: bool,\n    move_timer: u32,\n    move_interval: u32, // frames between moves\n    frames_elapsed: u32, // Track total frames to prevent immediate collision\n    needs_redraw: bool, // Track if we need to redraw\n    turn_locked: bool, // Allow at most one turn per movement step\n}\n\nimpl Default for GameState {\n    fn default() -&gt; Self {\n        Self {\n            score: 0,\n            game_over: false,\n            move_timer: 0,\n            move_interval: 6, // Even faster movement (was 8, originally 15)\n            frames_elapsed: 0,\n            needs_redraw: true, // Initial render needed\n            turn_locked: false,\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n#[derive(Resource)]\nstruct RngResource(Rng);\n\n#[derive(Resource, Default)]\nstruct InputState {\n    turn_left: bool,\n    turn_right: bool,\n    restart: bool,\n}\n\n#[derive(Resource, Default)]\nstruct DebugCounter {\n    count: u32,\n}\n\n#[derive(Resource)]\nstruct PerformanceMetrics {\n    frame_count: u32,\n    total_frame_time_us: u64,\n    max_frame_time_us: u64,\n    min_frame_time_us: u64,\n    last_log_frame: u32,\n    show_on_screen: bool,\n}\n\nimpl Default for PerformanceMetrics {\n    fn default() -&gt; Self {\n        Self {\n            frame_count: 0,\n            total_frame_time_us: 0,\n            max_frame_time_us: 0,\n            min_frame_time_us: u64::MAX,\n            last_log_frame: 0,\n            show_on_screen: true, // Show FPS on screen by default\n        }\n    }\n}\n\nimpl PerformanceMetrics {\n    fn record_frame(&amp;mut self, frame_time_us: u64) {\n        self.frame_count += 1;\n        self.total_frame_time_us += frame_time_us;\n        if frame_time_us &gt; self.max_frame_time_us {\n            self.max_frame_time_us = frame_time_us;\n        }\n        if frame_time_us &lt; self.min_frame_time_us {\n            self.min_frame_time_us = frame_time_us;\n        }\n    }\n    \n    fn log_performance(&amp;mut self) {\n        if self.frame_count == 0 {\n            return;\n        }\n        \n        let avg_frame_time_us = self.total_frame_time_us / self.frame_count as u64;\n        let avg_fps = if avg_frame_time_us &gt; 0 {\n            1_000_000 / avg_frame_time_us\n        } else {\n            0\n        };\n        \n        esp_println::println!(\"=== Performance ({} frames) ===\", self.frame_count);\n        esp_println::println!(\"  Avg: {} us ({} FPS)\", avg_frame_time_us, avg_fps);\n        esp_println::println!(\"  Min: {} us\", self.min_frame_time_us);\n        esp_println::println!(\"  Max: {} us\", self.max_frame_time_us);\n        \n        // Reset for next measurement period\n        self.frame_count = 0;\n        self.total_frame_time_us = 0;\n        self.max_frame_time_us = 0;\n        self.min_frame_time_us = u64::MAX;\n    }\n    \n    fn get_current_fps(&amp;self) -&gt; u32 {\n        if self.frame_count == 0 {\n            return 0;\n        }\n        let avg_frame_time_us = self.total_frame_time_us / self.frame_count as u64;\n        if avg_frame_time_us &gt; 0 {\n            (1_000_000 / avg_frame_time_us) as u32\n        } else {\n            0\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n\n#[derive(Resource, Default)]\nstruct ButtonState {\n    left_pressed: bool,\n    right_pressed: bool,\n    both_pressed_start: Option&lt;u32&gt;, // Frame when both buttons were pressed\n    single_button_hold_start: Option&lt;u32&gt;, // Frame when single button was pressed (for game-over restart)\n    last_frame: u32,\n    left_debounce: u32,\n    right_debounce: u32,\n}\n\nconst BOTH_BUTTONS_THRESHOLD: u32 = 5; // Frames both buttons must be held for restart\nconst SINGLE_BUTTON_RESTART_THRESHOLD: u32 = 30; // Frames single button must be held to restart when game over (~1 second)\n\n// Shared TCA9554 reset interface that uses Rc to share I2C bus\nstruct SharedTca9554Reset {\n    i2c: Rc&lt;core::cell::RefCell&lt;I2c&lt;'static, esp_hal::Blocking&gt;&gt;&gt;,\n    addr: u8,\n}\n\nimpl ResetInterface for SharedTca9554Reset {\n    type Error = &lt;I2c&lt;'static, esp_hal::Blocking&gt; as embedded_hal::i2c::ErrorType&gt;::Error;\n    \n    fn reset(&amp;mut self) -&gt; Result&lt;(), Self::Error&gt; {\n        let delay = Delay::new();\n        let mut i2c = self.i2c.borrow_mut();\n        i2c.write(self.addr, &amp;[TCA9554_CONFIG, 0b0111_1000])?;\n        i2c.write(self.addr, &amp;[TCA9554_POLARITY, 0x00])?;\n        i2c.write(self.addr, &amp;[TCA9554_OUTPUT, 0b1000_0110])?;\n        delay.delay_millis(20);\n        i2c.write(self.addr, &amp;[TCA9554_OUTPUT, 0b1000_0111])?;\n        delay.delay_millis(150);\n        Ok(())\n    }\n}\n\n// Type alias for the display driver to simplify the type\ntype DisplayDriver = Sh8601Driver&lt;\n    Ws18AmoledDriver,\n    SharedTca9554Reset,\n&gt;;\n\n// Display resource - NonSend because it contains non-thread-safe components\nstruct DisplayResource {\n    display: DisplayDriver,\n}\n\n// Button resources - NonSend because GPIO pins are not Send\nstruct ButtonLeftResource {\n    button: Input&lt;'static&gt;,\n}\n\n// TCA9554 resource for reading power button (EXIO4)\nstruct Tca9554Resource {\n    i2c: Rc&lt;core::cell::RefCell&lt;I2c&lt;'static, esp_hal::Blocking&gt;&gt;&gt;,\n    addr: u8,\n}\n\n// --- Game Systems ---\n\nfn input_system(\n    left_btn: NonSendMut&lt;ButtonLeftResource&gt;,\n    tca9554: NonSendMut&lt;Tca9554Resource&gt;,\n    mut input_state: ResMut&lt;InputState&gt;,\n    mut button_state: ResMut&lt;ButtonState&gt;,\n    mut debug_counter: ResMut&lt;DebugCounter&gt;,\n    game_state: Res&lt;GameState&gt;,\n) {\n    // GPIO0 (boot button) = left turn (active-low)\n    // EXIO4 (power button via TCA9554) = right turn (active-low)\n    // Both pressed = restart (during game)\n    // Single button long-press = restart (when game over)\n    let prev_left = button_state.left_pressed;\n    let prev_right = button_state.right_pressed;\n    let left_pressed = left_btn.button.is_low();\n    \n    // Read power button from TCA9554 EXIO4\n    let right_pressed = {\n        let mut i2c = tca9554.i2c.borrow_mut();\n        // Read input register (0x00)\n        let mut buf = [0u8; 1];\n        let read_result = i2c.write_read(tca9554.addr, &amp;[TCA9554_INPUT], &amp;mut buf);\n        if read_result.is_ok() {\n            // EXIO4 is bit 4, active-low (0 = pressed, 1 = not pressed)\n            // So we check if bit 4 is 0 (pressed) or 1 (not pressed)\n            (buf[0] &amp; (1 &lt;&lt; TCA9554_EXIO4_BIT)) == 0\n        } else {\n            false // On error, assume not pressed\n        }\n    };\n    let right_raw_low = right_pressed;\n    let right_raw_high = !right_pressed;\n    button_state.last_frame += 1;\n    \n    // Check for both buttons pressed (restart)\n    let both_pressed = left_pressed &amp;&amp; right_pressed;\n    let any_pressed = left_pressed || right_pressed;\n    \n    // When game is over, allow single-button long-press to restart\n    if game_state.game_over {\n        if any_pressed {\n            if button_state.single_button_hold_start.is_none() {\n                button_state.single_button_hold_start = Some(button_state.last_frame);\n                esp_println::println!(\"BTN: hold to restart...\");\n            } else if let Some(start_frame) = button_state.single_button_hold_start {\n                let hold_duration = button_state.last_frame - start_frame;\n                if hold_duration &gt;= SINGLE_BUTTON_RESTART_THRESHOLD &amp;&amp; !input_state.restart {\n                    input_state.restart = true;\n                    esp_println::println!(\"BTN: single button held long enough - restart!\");\n                }\n            }\n        } else {\n            button_state.single_button_hold_start = None;\n        }\n    } else {\n        button_state.single_button_hold_start = None;\n    }\n    \n    if both_pressed {\n        if !(prev_left &amp;&amp; prev_right) {\n            esp_println::println!(\"BTN: both pressed (boot+power)\");\n        }\n        // Both buttons pressed - check if held long enough for restart\n        if button_state.both_pressed_start.is_none() {\n            button_state.both_pressed_start = Some(button_state.last_frame);\n        } else if let Some(start_frame) = button_state.both_pressed_start {\n            let hold_duration = button_state.last_frame - start_frame;\n            if hold_duration &gt;= BOTH_BUTTONS_THRESHOLD {\n                input_state.restart = true;\n                esp_println::println!(\"BTN: both buttons held (restart)\");\n            }\n        }\n        // Don't process individual button presses when both are pressed\n        input_state.turn_left = false;\n        input_state.turn_right = false;\n    } else {\n        // Not both pressed - handle individual buttons\n        button_state.both_pressed_start = None;\n        // Don't clear restart flag here - let restart_system handle it\n        // input_state.restart = false; // Moved to restart_system\n        \n        // Simple debounce: button must be low for a few frames\n        if left_pressed {\n            button_state.left_debounce += 1;\n            if button_state.left_debounce &gt;= 3 {\n                input_state.turn_left = true;\n                if !prev_left &amp;&amp; button_state.left_debounce == 3 {\n                    esp_println::println!(\"BTN: left press (boot)\");\n                }\n            }\n        } else {\n            button_state.left_debounce = 0;\n            input_state.turn_left = false;\n        }\n        \n        if right_pressed {\n            button_state.right_debounce += 1;\n            if button_state.right_debounce &gt;= 3 {\n                input_state.turn_right = true;\n                if !prev_right &amp;&amp; button_state.right_debounce == 3 {\n                    esp_println::println!(\"BTN: right press (power/EXIO4)\");\n                }\n            }\n        } else {\n            button_state.right_debounce = 0;\n            input_state.turn_right = false;\n        }\n        \n        // Log any right button state change for debugging\n                if right_pressed != prev_right {\n                    esp_println::println!(\"BTN: Power button (EXIO4) {} (low={} high={})\", \n                        if right_pressed { \"pressed\" } else { \"released\" },\n                        right_raw_low, right_raw_high);\n                }\n    }\n    \n    button_state.left_pressed = left_pressed;\n    button_state.right_pressed = right_pressed;\n    \n    // Debug: log button states occasionally\n    debug_counter.count += 1;\n    if debug_counter.count % 100 == 0 {\n        esp_println::println!(\"BTN: left={} right={} (raw: low={} high={}) both={} game_over={}\", \n            left_pressed, right_pressed, right_raw_low, right_raw_high, both_pressed, game_state.game_over);\n    }\n}\n\nfn process_input_system(\n    mut input_state: ResMut&lt;InputState&gt;,\n    mut game_state: ResMut&lt;GameState&gt;,\n    mut head_query: Query&lt;&amp;mut Direction, With&lt;SnakeHead&gt;&gt;,\n) {\n    // Handle restart first (works even when game is over)\n    if input_state.restart {\n        // Restart will be handled by restart_system; skip other input\n        return;\n    }\n    \n    // Only process turn inputs if game is not over\n    if game_state.game_over {\n        return;\n    }\n    \n    // Lock turning until the snake moves again.\n    // This prevents \"multiple 90° turns while standing still\" which can effectively reverse direction\n    // before a move step and cause an unexpected immediate self-collision.\n    if game_state.turn_locked {\n        // still clear one-shot flags to avoid building up a backlog and spamming logs\n        input_state.turn_left = false;\n        input_state.turn_right = false;\n        return;\n    }\n\n    if let Ok(mut dir) = head_query.single_mut() {\n        // Process only one input per frame to avoid conflicts\n        // Right takes priority if both are pressed (shouldn't happen with new logic)\n        if input_state.turn_right {\n            *dir = dir.turn_right();\n            game_state.turn_locked = true;\n            game_state.needs_redraw = true;\n            input_state.turn_right = false;\n            esp_println::println!(\"Input: turn right\");\n        } else if input_state.turn_left {\n            *dir = dir.turn_left();\n            game_state.turn_locked = true;\n            game_state.needs_redraw = true;\n            input_state.turn_left = false;\n            esp_println::println!(\"Input: turn left\");\n        }\n    }\n}\n\nfn move_snake_system(\n    mut game_state: ResMut&lt;GameState&gt;,\n    mut head_query: Query&lt;(&amp;mut Position, &amp;Direction), With&lt;SnakeHead&gt;&gt;,\n    mut segment_query: Query&lt;(&amp;mut Position, &amp;SnakeSegment), (With&lt;SnakeSegment&gt;, Without&lt;SnakeHead&gt;)&gt;,\n) {\n    if game_state.game_over {\n        return;\n    }\n\n    game_state.frames_elapsed += 1;\n    game_state.move_timer += 1;\n    if game_state.move_timer &lt; game_state.move_interval {\n        return;\n    }\n    game_state.move_timer = 0;\n    game_state.needs_redraw = true; // Mark that we need to redraw after movement\n    game_state.turn_locked = false; // Allow another turn after each movement step\n\n    let (mut head_pos, direction) = match head_query.single_mut() {\n        Ok(h) =&gt; h,\n        Err(_) =&gt; return,\n    };\n\n    // Calculate new head position\n    let new_head_pos = match *direction {\n        Direction::Up =&gt; Position {\n            x: head_pos.x,\n            y: head_pos.y - 1,\n        },\n        Direction::Down =&gt; Position {\n            x: head_pos.x,\n            y: head_pos.y + 1,\n        },\n        Direction::Left =&gt; Position {\n            x: head_pos.x - 1,\n            y: head_pos.y,\n        },\n        Direction::Right =&gt; Position {\n            x: head_pos.x + 1,\n            y: head_pos.y,\n        },\n    };\n\n    // Store old head position\n    let old_head_pos = *head_pos;\n    \n    // Update head to new position\n    *head_pos = new_head_pos;\n\n    // Correct implementation of snake movement using indices\n    \n    // 1. Collect all segment data (index, old_position) BEFORE any updates\n    let mut segment_data: heapless::Vec&lt;(usize, Position), 256&gt; = heapless::Vec::new();\n    for (pos, seg) in segment_query.iter() {\n        segment_data.push((seg.index, *pos)).ok();\n    }\n    \n    // 2. Sort by index (ascending: 0, 1, 2...)\n    segment_data.sort_unstable_by_key(|(idx, _)| *idx);\n    \n    // Validate segment_data: check for duplicate indices or missing indices\n    let mut prev_idx = None;\n    for (idx, _) in segment_data.iter() {\n        if let Some(prev) = prev_idx {\n            if *idx == prev {\n                esp_println::println!(\"MOVE: ERROR - duplicate segment index {}\", idx);\n            } else if *idx != prev + 1 {\n                esp_println::println!(\"MOVE: WARNING - non-contiguous indices: {} -&gt; {}\", prev, idx);\n            }\n        }\n        prev_idx = Some(*idx);\n    }\n    \n    // Debug: log collected segment data occasionally (kept lightweight)\n    if segment_data.len() &gt; 0 &amp;&amp; game_state.frames_elapsed % 200 == 0 {\n        esp_println::println!(\n            \"MOVE: head old=({}, {}) new=({}, {}) segs={}\",\n            old_head_pos.x,\n            old_head_pos.y,\n            new_head_pos.x,\n            new_head_pos.y,\n            segment_data.len()\n        );\n    }\n    \n    // 3. Update segments in index order (0, 1, 2...) to ensure correctness\n    // We iterate through indices sequentially and find each segment by its index\n    let max_index = segment_data.iter().map(|(idx, _)| *idx).max().unwrap_or(0);\n    \n    for target_idx in 0..=max_index {\n        // Find the segment with this index and update it\n        for (mut pos, seg) in segment_query.iter_mut() {\n            if seg.index == target_idx {\n                if target_idx == 0 {\n                    // Segment 0 gets the old head position\n                    *pos = old_head_pos;\n                } else {\n                    // Segment i gets the old position of segment i-1\n                    // Find the old position of segment (target_idx - 1) in segment_data\n                    if let Some((prev_idx, prev_pos)) = segment_data.iter().find(|(idx, _)| *idx == target_idx - 1) {\n                        // Critical check: if the previous segment's old position is the new head position,\n                        // this indicates a serious bug in the movement logic\n                        if *prev_pos == new_head_pos {\n                            esp_println::println!(\"MOVE: CRITICAL ERROR - segment {} prev_seg[{}] old_pos=({}, {}) == new_head=({}, {})\", \n                                target_idx, prev_idx, prev_pos.x, prev_pos.y, new_head_pos.x, new_head_pos.y);\n                            esp_println::println!(\"MOVE: This should never happen! segment_data may be corrupted.\");\n                            // Don't update - leave segment at current position to avoid crash\n                            // Break out of inner loop to move to next target_idx\n                        } else {\n                            *pos = *prev_pos;\n                            \n                            // Debug: log segment updates occasionally\n                            if target_idx &lt;= 2 &amp;&amp; game_state.frames_elapsed % 50 == 0 {\n                                esp_println::println!(\"MOVE: updated segment {} to ({}, {})\", target_idx, pos.x, pos.y);\n                            }\n                        }\n                    } else {\n                        esp_println::println!(\"MOVE: ERROR - segment {} could not find previous segment {} in segment_data\", target_idx, target_idx - 1);\n                    }\n                }\n                \n                // Found this segment (whether updated or not), move to next index\n                break;\n            }\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n\nfn dump_game_state(\n    reason: &amp;str,\n    head_pos: &amp;Position,\n    head_dir: &amp;Direction,\n    game_state: &amp;GameState,\n    segment_query: &amp;Query&lt;(&amp;Position, &amp;SnakeSegment), (With&lt;SnakeSegment&gt;, Without&lt;SnakeHead&gt;)&gt;,\n    food_query: &amp;Query&lt;(Entity, &amp;Position), With&lt;Food&gt;&gt;,\n) {\n    const GRID_WIDTH: i32 = 46;\n    const GRID_HEIGHT: i32 = 56;\n    \n    let dir_str = match head_dir {\n        Direction::Up =&gt; \"Up\",\n        Direction::Down =&gt; \"Down\",\n        Direction::Left =&gt; \"Left\",\n        Direction::Right =&gt; \"Right\",\n    };\n    \n    esp_println::println!(\"=== GAME OVER: {} ===\", reason);\n    esp_println::println!(\"  Head: ({}, {}) facing {}\", head_pos.x, head_pos.y, dir_str);\n    esp_println::println!(\"  Grid: {}x{} (valid: 0..{}, 0..{})\", GRID_WIDTH, GRID_HEIGHT, GRID_WIDTH-1, GRID_HEIGHT-1);\n    esp_println::println!(\"  Score: {}, Frames: {}, Speed: {}\", game_state.score, game_state.frames_elapsed, game_state.move_interval);\n    \n    // Collect and sort segments by index\n    let mut segments: heapless::Vec&lt;(usize, i32, i32), 64&gt; = heapless::Vec::new();\n    for (pos, seg) in segment_query.iter() {\n        segments.push((seg.index, pos.x, pos.y)).ok();\n    }\n    segments.sort_unstable_by_key(|(idx, _, _)| *idx);\n    \n    esp_println::println!(\"  Segments ({}):\", segments.len());\n    for (idx, x, y) in segments.iter() {\n        esp_println::println!(\"    [{}]: ({}, {})\", idx, x, y);\n    }\n    \n    // Food positions\n    let mut food_count = 0;\n    for (_, food_pos) in food_query.iter() {\n        esp_println::println!(\"  Food: ({}, {})\", food_pos.x, food_pos.y);\n        food_count += 1;\n    }\n    if food_count == 0 {\n        esp_println::println!(\"  Food: none\");\n    }\n    esp_println::println!(\"=== END STATE DUMP ===\");\n}\n\nfn collision_system(\n    mut game_state: ResMut&lt;GameState&gt;,\n    head_query: Query&lt;(&amp;Position, &amp;Direction), With&lt;SnakeHead&gt;&gt;,\n    segment_query: Query&lt;(&amp;Position, &amp;SnakeSegment), (With&lt;SnakeSegment&gt;, Without&lt;SnakeHead&gt;)&gt;,\n    food_query: Query&lt;(Entity, &amp;Position), With&lt;Food&gt;&gt;,\n    mut commands: Commands,\n) {\n    if game_state.game_over {\n        return;\n    }\n\n    // Don't check collisions until snake has moved at least once\n    // This prevents false collisions on the first frame\n    if game_state.frames_elapsed &lt; game_state.move_interval {\n        return;\n    }\n\n    let (head_pos, head_dir) = match head_query.single() {\n        Ok((p, d)) =&gt; (*p, *d),\n        Err(_) =&gt; return,\n    };\n\n    // Check wall collision\n    const GRID_WIDTH: i32 = 46; // 368 / 8\n    const GRID_HEIGHT: i32 = 56; // 448 / 8\n    \n    if head_pos.x &lt; 0\n        || head_pos.x &gt;= GRID_WIDTH\n        || head_pos.y &lt; 0\n        || head_pos.y &gt;= GRID_HEIGHT\n    {\n        game_state.game_over = true;\n        game_state.needs_redraw = true;\n        dump_game_state(\"Wall collision\", &amp;head_pos, &amp;head_dir, &amp;game_state, &amp;segment_query, &amp;food_query);\n        return;\n    }\n\n    // Check self collision\n    // Skip segment 0 (index 0) because it's always at the old head position right after movement\n    // This prevents false collisions. Only check segments 1 and beyond.\n    for (seg_pos, seg) in segment_query.iter() {\n        if seg.index &gt; 0 &amp;&amp; *seg_pos == head_pos {\n            game_state.game_over = true;\n            game_state.needs_redraw = true;\n            esp_println::println!(\"=== GAME OVER: Self collision with segment {} ===\", seg.index);\n            dump_game_state(\"Self collision\", &amp;head_pos, &amp;head_dir, &amp;game_state, &amp;segment_query, &amp;food_query);\n            return;\n        }\n    }\n\n    // Check food collision\n    for (food_entity, food_pos) in food_query.iter() {\n        if *food_pos == head_pos {\n            // Eat food\n            commands.entity(food_entity).despawn();\n            game_state.score += 10;\n            \n            // Add new segment to snake\n            // Find the last segment (highest index)\n            // Use index to find tail, not position order which can be misleading if coiled\n            let max_index_seg = segment_query\n                .iter()\n                .max_by_key(|(_, s)| s.index);\n                \n            let (last_pos, next_index) = if let Some((pos, s)) = max_index_seg {\n                (*pos, s.index + 1)\n            } else {\n                (head_pos, 0)\n            };\n            \n            commands.spawn((\n                SnakeSegment { index: next_index },\n                Position {\n                    x: last_pos.x,\n                    y: last_pos.y,\n                },\n            ));\n\n            // Speed up slightly\n            if game_state.move_interval &gt; 2 {\n                game_state.move_interval -= 1;\n            }\n            game_state.needs_redraw = true;\n\n            esp_println::println!(\"Score: {}\", game_state.score);\n        }\n    }\n}\n\nfn restart_system(\n    mut input_state: ResMut&lt;InputState&gt;,\n    mut game_state: ResMut&lt;GameState&gt;,\n    mut head_query: Query&lt;&amp;mut Position, With&lt;SnakeHead&gt;&gt;,\n    mut head_dir_query: Query&lt;&amp;mut Direction, With&lt;SnakeHead&gt;&gt;,\n    segment_query: Query&lt;Entity, With&lt;SnakeSegment&gt;&gt;,\n    food_query: Query&lt;Entity, With&lt;Food&gt;&gt;,\n    mut commands: Commands,\n) {\n    if !input_state.restart {\n        return;\n    }\n    \n    esp_println::println!(\"=== RESTART SYSTEM TRIGGERED ===\");\n    esp_println::println!(\"  game_over was: {}\", game_state.game_over);\n    \n    // Clear restart flag immediately to prevent multiple restarts\n    input_state.restart = false;\n    \n    // Reset game state\n    *game_state = GameState::default();\n    \n    // Remove all segments\n    for entity in segment_query.iter() {\n        commands.entity(entity).despawn();\n ---

### What was happening (and why it spammed)

Your control scheme allows **turn inputs every frame**, but the snake only **moves every `move_interval` frames**. That means you can do multiple 90° turns “in place” before the next movement tick, which can effectively **reverse direction without moving** → next move steps into the body → “out of nowhere” collision.

My earlier “block if next cell equals segment0” approach was wrong for this control model and also produced the log spam (held button ⇒ repeated rejected turns ⇒ repeated prints).

### Holistic fix implemented

- **One turn per movement step**:
  - Added `GameState.turn_locked`.
  - `process_input_system` accepts **at most one** left/right turn, then sets `turn_locked = true`.
  - `move_snake_system` clears `turn_locked = false` **only when a move happens**.
- **Removed** the bad “segment0 collision” gate and its spammy “ignored” logs.
- **Reduced** movement debug logging frequency/volume.

This keeps your “only 90° turns” behavior, but prevents “spin twice before moving” from creating an unintended reverse.

If you still want “hold button to keep turning”, you’ll now get **one turn per move step** instead of per-frame spam, which matches the game’s discrete movement model.

---

### Summary of Comprehensive Fix

**Root cause**: 
1. EXIO4 on TCA9554 was constantly reading as "pressed" (either not connected to a button, or wrong polarity)
2. Per the PDF schematic notes, this board only has GPIO0 (BOOT) as a user button - EXIO4/power button doesn't exist as a user input
3. The old input system set `turn_right=true` every frame while held, overwhelming any turn-locking mechanism

**Changes made**:

1. **Removed EXIO4/TCA9554 button reading** - it was causing phantom presses
2. **Simplified to single-button control** (GPIO0/BOOT only):
   - **Press** = turn left (edge-triggered, one turn per press)
   - **Hold when game over** = restart (~2 seconds)

Excellent find! This Arduino example reveals the **actual button configuration**:

## Key Discoveries

### 1. GPIO0 (BOOT button)
```cpp
pinMode(0, INPUT);  // Line 238
```
Direct GPIO input - works as expected.

### 2. Power Button via AXP2101 PMU (NOT GPIO!)
The "power button" is **not** a regular GPIO - it's wired to the **AXP2101 PMU** and read via its **interrupt system**:

```cpp
// Enable power key short press interrupt
power.enableIRQ(XPOWERS_AXP2101_PKEY_SHORT_IRQ);  // Line 168-170

// In loop - check if power key was pressed
if (power.isPekeyShortPressIrq()) {
    // Handle power button press!
    // ...
}
power.clearIrqStatus();  // Line 268
```

### 3. EXIO4 is NOT a user button
EXIO4 is used for **backlight control**, not a button:
```cpp
expander.pinMode(4, INPUT);  // Line 149
int backlight_ctrl = expander.digitalRead(4);  // Line 245
```

### 4. EXIO5 is PMU interrupt line
```cpp
expander.pinMode(5, INPUT);  // Line 148
int pmu_irq = expander.digitalRead(5);  // Line 158 - triggers PMU flag
```

## What This Means

To get **two buttons** on this board:
1. **GPIO0** - Direct GPIO read (already working)
2. **AXP2101 Power Key** - Need to initialize PMU, enable `PKEY_SHORT_IRQ`, and check `isPekeyShortPressIrq()`

This requires adding the **XPowersLib** (or equivalent Rust crate) to read the PMU's power key press events via I2C.

    uint64_t getIrqStatus(void)
    {
        statusRegister[0] = readRegister(XPOWERS_AXP2101_INTSTS1);
        statusRegister[1] = readRegister(XPOWERS_AXP2101_INTSTS2);
        statusRegister[2] = readRegister(XPOWERS_AXP2101_INTSTS3);
        return (uint32_t)(statusRegister[0] &lt;&lt; 16) | (uint32_t)(statusRegister[1] &lt;&lt; 8) | (uint32_t)(statusRegister[2]);
    }


    /**
     * @brief  Clear interrupt controller state.
     */
    void clearIrqStatus()
    {
        for (int i = 0; i &lt; XPOWERS_AXP2101_INTSTS_CNT; i++) {
            writeRegister(XPOWERS_AXP2101_INTSTS1 + i, 0xFF);
            statusRegister[i] = 0;
        }
    }

    /*
    *  @brief  Debug interrupt setting register
    * */
#ifdef ARDUINO
    void printIntRegister(Stream *stream)
    {
        for (int i = 0; i &lt; XPOWERS_AXP2101_INTSTS_CNT; i++) {
            uint8_t val =  readRegister(XPOWERS_AXP2101_INTEN1 + i);
            stream-&gt;print("INT["); stream-&gt;print(i);
            stream-&gt;print(']');
            stream-&gt;print("  HEX: "); stream-&gt;print(val, HEX);
            stream-&gt;print(" BIN:0b"); stream-&gt;println(val, BIN);
        }
    }
#else
    void printIntRegister()
    {
        for (int i = 0; i &lt; XPOWERS_AXP2101_INTSTS_CNT; i++) {
            uint8_t val =  readRegister(XPOWERS_AXP2101_INTEN1 + i);
            printf("INT[%d] HEX:0x%X\n", i, val);
        }
    }
#endif

    /**
     * @brief  Enable PMU interrupt control mask .
     * @param  opt: View the related chip type xpowers_axp2101_irq_t enumeration
     *              parameters in "XPowersParams.hpp"
     * @retval
     */
    bool enableIRQ(uint64_t opt)
    {
        return setInterruptImpl(opt, true);
    }

    /**
     * @brief  Disable PMU interrupt control mask .
     * @param  opt: View the related chip type xpowers_axp2101_irq_t enumeration
     *              parameters in "XPowersParams.hpp"
     * @retval
     */
    bool disableIRQ(uint64_t opt)
    {
        return setInterruptImpl(opt, false);
    }

    //IRQ STATUS 0
    bool isDropWarningLevel2Irq(void)
    {
        uint8_t mask = XPOWERS_AXP2101_WARNING_LEVEL2_IRQ;
        if (intRegister[0] &amp; mask) {
            return IS_BIT_SET(statusRegister[0], mask);
        }
        return false;
    }
